template.name: Demo GPT - Day Trading Scalping
template.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,{p0}) > {p0} and volume_ratio(volume,{p1}) > {p2}
template.exit_long: close < open and roc(close,1) < {p1} and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1
template.notes: Two green bars with volume above the 20-bar average become a positive bar plus positive 1-bar return and volume_ratio > 1, with the mirrored red-bar exit. The open-versus-prior-close condition needs shifted opens; EMA(20), VWAP and Camarilla levels are reference-only and unused.
